signatureGroups.interpretation: COOP iframe-opened popup retained its name where the assertion expected it cleared.
Target-name round-trip stash result differed for base/form/link target cases. The failure message does not expose the returned value.
formatBlock produced one div with a br instead of two sibling divs.
A still-passing constructor error case includes different TypeError message text in its generated subtest name.
Button-targeted form submissions with noreferrer sent a nonempty referrer.
The query-encoding embed probe reported fallback width 300 instead of image width 2. This alone does not establish a URL encoding failure.
Text searches inside shadow-root dialogs returned false, including a slotted-text case.
formatBlock returned an empty query value instead of div.
Worker fetch observed 200 for the expected 204 POST/304 OPTIONS response.
A literal %s followed by a dynamic wptserve port appears in this generated name; the unchanged canonicalizer does not rewrite this token.
createImageBitmap rejected two cross-origin/redirect video sources with an InvalidStateError decode diagnostic.
The cloned ImageBitmap subtest timed out on a page reporting a harness error.
The old filename-derived passing name was absent. Current LP and signed Chrome both reported a descriptive failing assertion on the same complete page.
Sequential focus remained on the preceding element rather than the expected iframe.
The noopener/named-iframe case timed out before a final opener assertion.
Cross-origin navigation with noopener returned an unexpected stash value. The raw assertion does not identify the wrong field.
A data-URL iframe exposed FileSystemDirectoryHandle when the assertion expected it absent.
Bold markup was absent from the designMode/plaintext-only result.
A service-worker text import reported LOADED when the assertion expected FAILED.
Insertion at the end of a link placed the new character outside the link.
A drawImage pixel was transparent black instead of opaque red.
The dedicated-worker static data-URL import assertion returned false; no lower-level diagnostic was supplied.
